list_episodes.description: Browse the Final Space episode guide, or only the episodes matching a title, a director, a writer, a year, or the ones a particular character is in. That last filter is the join the API publishes only in reverse (an episode lists its cast, but nothing lists a character's episodes), so it is resolved here. Every row carries its air date as an ISO date as well as the service's own spelling. Worth knowing: the show ran to 36 episodes over three seasons, but the data this service publishes stops at the end of season two, so the guide holds 23.

description: Look up the characters, episodes, locations and quotes of Final Space, Olan Rogers' animated series about Gary Goodspeed and his alien friend Mooncake. Find a character by name and get their species, their home world and every episode they are in; read an episode with its cast named and pictured; browse the places in the show and who lives there; or pull a line at random for a channel or a fan page. The service keys everything by number and offers no search, so names are resolved here. No account or API key is required.
